note: Which TypeSpec/TCGC/emitter feature would remove each pattern, and whether it exists today. Drafted from an AI mapping of pattern descriptions and samples to the TCGC docs (October 2026); judgments, not verified per instance. Edit by pull request. coverage: exists (decorators exist, specs do not use them), partial (exists but misses cases), gap (new feature needed), spec-fix, not-generator.

NG.name: Not generator work (handwritten runtime behavior)
NG.what: Transfers, batching, encryption, websockets, caches, lifecycles, service-specific logic.

clientInit.name: @clientInitialization + @paramAlias + @clientLocation
clientInit.what: Elevate operation params (topic, subscription, project name) to the client; sub-clients initialized by parent accessors.
clientInit.doc: TCGC reference/decorators.md; howtos/Generate client libraries/03client.mdx 'Adding Client Initialization Parameters' / 'Change Sub Client Initialization Way'

override.name: @override + replaceParameter/removeParameter/addParameter/reorderParameters
override.what: Reshape one convenience signature per operation: options bag, spread, required/optional, reorder.
override.doc: TCGC reference/decorators.md (@override); howtos/Generate client libraries/04method.mdx 'Customizing method signatures with @override' (transform functions are experimental)

P_backCompat.name: Back-compat surface from the previous GA (obsolete shims, legacy overloads, renamed members)
P_backCompat.what: Let a spec (or an API baseline file) mark removed/renamed members, overloads and enum values to be emitted as obsolete forwarding shims, including prior-version overloads when an optional parameter is added.
P_backCompat.whyShort: rename/reshape replaces the old surface; nothing keeps the old name or signature alongside as obsolete

P_lroPolling.name: Custom LRO polling semantics on the poller
P_lroPolling.what: Extend LRO metadata with polling strategies (poll resource until state, delete-until-gone), expose the operation id, allow a named public operation/poller type, and require continuation-token rehydration in every emitter. Overlaps the LRO-unification proposal.
P_lroPolling.whyShort: cover standard status-monitor/Operation-Location flows; cannot express state-based polling of a resource, delete-until-404, initial 200 = in progress, operation id exposure, typed operation classes or rehydration tokens consistently across emitters

P_modelProjection.name: Client model projection (public model <-> wire model mapping)
P_modelProjection.what: Let a spec declare a public client model whose fields map (rename, flatten, default, derive) onto the wire model; emitters generate to/from conversion, page-item projection and convenience methods that take/return the public model.
P_modelProjection.whyShort: swaps the type wholesale but generates no field-by-field conversion, so the mapping code stays handwritten

P_audience.name: Cloud-aware token audience/scope as a client option
P_audience.what: Model the bearer-token audience as a client option with known per-cloud values (public, China, US Gov) and an endpoint-derived default; emitters generate the option, the scope composition (+/.default) and audience-error guidance.
P_audience.whyShort: scopes are fixed strings in the spec/config; no client option to pick an audience or cloud, or derive it from the endpoint

clientName.name: @clientName (+ exact())
clientName.what: Renames clients, models, properties, parameters, operations and enum members per language.

P_propertyAlias.name: Model property aliases and computed properties
P_propertyAlias.what: Add alias properties (old name -> new property) and simple computed properties (e.g. id parsed from a URL) to generated models.
P_propertyAlias.whyShort: @clientName renames a property but cannot keep a second name or add a derived getter

P_modelCtors.name: Model constructor overloads (per one-of variant / required-property sets)
P_modelCtors.what: Generate named constructors or factories for input models, one per union/one-of variant (URL vs bytes) or per required-property subset, including fixed-discriminator variants.
P_modelCtors.whyShort: no TCGC decorator shapes model constructors

P_responseProjection.name: Response projection (unwrap envelope, headers into result, status -> value)
P_responseProjection.what: Declare that a method returns a nested property, a model built from headers+body, or a per-status value (304 -> None, 404 -> false on DELETE/GET).
P_responseProjection.whyShort: @responseAsBool is HEAD-only and not supported in Go; the response replacements are NOT_SUPPORTED in Python/C#/Java; header projection is a TS-only option

P_authSchemes.name: Azure auth schemes beyond bearer/key (shared-key HMAC, challenge-based bearer, custom auth headers)
P_authSchemes.what: Named, runtime-backed auth schemes (Azure SharedKey/HMAC signing, Key Vault/ACR style challenge auth, extra subscription-key/region headers) that emitters map to the core library's policies and credential types.
P_authSchemes.closestExisting: @useAuth (TCGC only supports HttpAuth); typespec-ts custom-http-auth-header-name / custom-http-auth-shared-key-prefix
P_authSchemes.whyShort: HttpAuth cannot express HMAC request signing or WWW-Authenticate challenge flows; the TS options cover only a custom key header in one language

access.name: @access / @scope / @convenientAPI / @protocolAPI
access.what: Make generated methods/types internal, drop them per language, or turn convenience/protocol generation on or off.

P_ctorOptions.name: Client constructor overload configuration
P_ctorOptions.what: Declare constructor overloads per credential with defaulted options, settings-object constructors and DI/builder registration for each, so C#/Python stop hand-writing them.
P_ctorOptions.whyShort: controls which parameters are on the client, not overloads, default options, settings objects or optional api_version keywords

alternateType.name: @alternateType (incl. external types)
alternateType.what: Swap a property/parameter/model type for another TypeSpec type or an external type (e.g. azure-core CloudEvent).
alternateType.doc: TCGC reference/decorators.md; howtos/Generate client libraries/08types.mdx 'Using @alternateType to Reference External Types'

useAuth.name: @useAuth with multiple schemes (incl. NoAuth)
useAuth.what: Generates one constructor/credential union per declared HttpAuth scheme; NoAuth gives a credential-less option.
useAuth.doc: TCGC guideline.md 'Client' and 'Client Initialization Creation'; typespec-ts emitter.md add-credentials

P_connectionString.name: Connection-string client construction
P_connectionString.what: Declare a connection-string format on the client (keys -> endpoint/credential/extra path parts) so emitters generate fromConnectionString constructors/factories and parsing.
P_connectionString.whyShort: describes the key header only; nothing describes a connection-string format (Endpoint=;Id=;Secret=) or which credential it yields

P_errors.name: Typed error mapping (status/error code -> named exception)
P_errors.what: Map specific statuses/error codes (409 read-only, 404 on a given op) to named exception types and expose the error model on the language's exception type.
P_errors.whyShort: no TCGC decorator maps a status or error code to a public exception type

P_serialization.name: Serialization hooks for null-aware/conditional fields and custom codecs
P_serialization.what: Per-property serialization policies (emit explicit null, omit empty) and a sanctioned hook for a custom codec.
P_serialization.whyShort: cover scalar encodings and merge-patch but not 'write explicit null when set', 'omit when empty' or per-model custom readers

P_modelDisplay.name: Generated model display and value equality
P_modelDisplay.what: Emit toString/repr and (for value types) equality/hash code from the model definition.

P_overloads.name: Multiple convenience methods per operation (union-input overloads, preset-argument variants)
P_overloads.what: Allow several client methods to bind to one operation, e.g. analyze(url) / analyze(bytes) from a union, or createIfNotExists = create with If-None-Match: *; also one method dispatching to operations by input.
P_overloads.whyShort: allows exactly one replacement signature per operation per language; union-typed inputs are not split into overloads

apiVersion.name: @clientApiVersions / @apiVersion / Azure.Core @previewVersion
apiVersion.what: Control the client's api-version parameter and the version enum.
apiVersion.doc: TCGC reference/decorators.md; azure-core reference/decorators.md; howtos/Generate client libraries/10versioning.mdx

specFix.name: Type the value correctly in the service TypeSpec
specFix.what: duration/utcDateTime with @encode, uuid, url, extensible union instead of string/int.
specFix.doc: howtos/Generate client libraries/08types.mdx (scalars, unions, @encode); azure-core reference/data-types.md

paging.name: Paging metadata (next link / continuation token) + Legacy @nextLinkVerb/@markAsPageable/@disablePageable
paging.what: Generated pagers incl. continuation tokens; hides the token parameter.

encode.name: @encode on scalars (TypeSpec core)
encode.what: Wire encoding for datetime/duration/bytes so emitters serialize native types.
encode.doc: howtos/Generate client libraries/08types.mdx 'Scalars > Encoding' (decorator itself is TypeSpec core, not in this repo's reference)

convenience.name: Convenience-method coverage (@convenientAPI, generate-convenience-methods)
convenience.what: Convenience methods for every operation; gaps where an emitter falls back to protocol-only (C# multipart, merge-patch bodies, content-type parameters).
convenience.doc: TCGC reference/decorators.md; TCGC reference/emitter.md; howtos/Generate client libraries/07multipart.mdx

P_flags.name: Flag-set <-> compact string encoding
P_flags.what: Encode a set of boolean flags as an ordered letter string (permissions 'racwd', include lists) with generated parse/format.

tracing.name: Tracing on generated methods (Go inject-spans)
tracing.what: Spans are emitted on generated methods; handwritten wrappers re-add them by hand. Disappears once the wrapper is generated.

P_clientProps.name: Expose client initialization values as properties
P_clientProps.what: Generate read-only client properties for the endpoint and every client-level parameter (vault URL, share name, topic).
P_clientProps.whyShort: adds client-level parameters but does not require emitters to expose endpoint/bound names as public getters

P_identifiers.name: Typed data-plane identifiers with parse helpers
P_identifiers.what: An identifier scalar with a template (e.g. {vault}/secrets/{name}/{version}) that emitters turn into a parse/format type.
P_identifiers.whyShort: ARM-only scalar; data-plane ids (Key Vault object URLs, registry ids) have no typed form

streaming.name: Streaming bodies (JsonlStream / SSEStream / HttpStream)
streaming.what: TypeSpec can describe JSONL and SSE streams; every emitter tab in the doc says 'unsupported'.

extEnum.name: Extensible enums from TypeSpec unions
extEnum.what: union { string, "a", "b" } generates an extensible enum in every language.

clientDefault.name: Legacy @clientDefaultValue
clientDefault.what: Client-side default for a property or parameter. Python: not supported yet.
clientDefault.doc: TCGC reference/decorators.md (Legacy); howtos/Generate client libraries/08types.mdx 'Client Default Values (Legacy)'

P_endpoint.name: Endpoint normalization/derivation rules
P_endpoint.what: Optional endpoint rules (default scheme, trailing slash, secondary host suffix) applied by generated constructors.
P_endpoint.whyShort: describe the URL template only; no rule for adding scheme, trimming slash or deriving a secondary host

matchConditions.name: Conditional request headers -> MatchConditions/etag
matchConditions.what: If-Match/If-None-Match collapse to etag+match_condition (Python), MatchConditions (C#, Java); Go and TS keep raw header options.

javaValidation.name: Client-side validation from TypeSpec constraints (Java client-side-validations)
javaValidation.what: Only Java exposes an emitter option; other languages validate required args only.

multipart.name: @multipartBody convenience methods
multipart.what: Typed multipart models with file parts. C# emits protocol method only.

hierarchy.name: Legacy @hierarchyBuilding
hierarchy.what: Change a model's base type in the SDK.

lro.name: Azure.Core LRO decorators (@lroStatus, @pollingOperation, @operationLink, @finalLocation, @useFinalStateVia, @lroResult)
lro.what: Describe status field, polling link, final result so emitters generate standard pollers.

P_discriminator.name: Discriminator defaulting and unknown-variant handling
P_discriminator.what: Declare a default discriminator value and unknown-kind behavior.
P_discriminator.whyShort: no way to declare a default variant or how to treat a missing/unknown kind

P_logAllowlist.name: Loggable header/query annotation
P_logAllowlist.what: Mark non-secret headers/query parameters so emitters add them to the HTTP logging allowlist.
P_logAllowlist.whyShort: no decorator marks headers as safe to log

P_unionsCSharp.name: Union-typed model properties in C#
P_unionsCSharp.what: Generate a C# union wrapper with typed accessors and JSON read/write.
P_unionsCSharp.whyShort: C# has no union type, so it falls back to BinaryData and handwritten codecs

emptyString.name: @deserializeEmptyStringAsNull
emptyString.what: Treat "" as null when deserializing a property.

P_preview.name: Per-member preview/experimental markers
P_preview.what: Emit language-specific experimental annotations on members that only exist in preview versions.
P_preview.whyShort: marks a version as preview, not individual types or methods

P_generic.name: Caller-typed generic payloads
P_generic.what: Mark a document/payload property as a type parameter so request/result/page types are generic over the caller's model (Search documents).
P_generic.whyShort: no way to mark a model property as caller-typed

responseAsBool.name: @responseAsBool / head-as-boolean
responseAsBool.doc: TCGC reference/decorators.md; howtos/Generate client libraries/04method.mdx; typespec-go and typespec-python emitter.md 'head-as-boolean'

stjConverter.name: @useSystemTextJsonConverter (C# only)
stjConverter.what: Back-compat JSON converter for C# models.

alternative-input-forms.note: string | string[] | model inputs, URL vs bytes.

api-documentation-correction.note: Java doc/snippet fixes; @clientDoc covers doc text, not framework annotations.

api-version-validation.note: Version enum/defaults exist; curating or rejecting specific versions per client is not expressible.

auth-audience-error-translation.note: needs-judgment; would come with the audience option.

auth-builder-traits.note: Java builder credential traits follow from @useAuth schemes; connection-string trait needs the connection-string feature.

binarydata-accessor.note: @alternateType(unknown) gives BinaryData in C#; typed accessors over it are handwritten.

bound-resource-operation-overload.note: Mgmt C# resource-bound overloads; @clientInitialization elevates the names, but mgmt resource classes are generated by the mgmt emitter's own resource model.

cached-subclient-factory.note: Accessor exists; caching of the child instance is emitter-specific.

client-uri-variant.note: Clone-for-snapshot/version is close to a parent accessor with a parameter; URL rewriting stays handwritten.

conditional-field-serialization.note: Merge-patch usage covers explicit null for PATCH bodies; other null/omit rules are handwritten.

conditional-operation-dispatch.note: One public method choosing between generated ops; @sharedRoute + @clientName merge only covers ops on the same route.

conditional-request-parameters.note: MatchConditions generated in Python/C#/Java; missing: raw if_none_match kept for back-compat, create-only (If-None-Match: *) variants, typed ETag on mgmt delete; Go/TS keep raw headers.

convenience-options-unpacking.note: @override covers bundling params into an options model (one signature per op); overloads that build the options from simple inputs (AnalyzeText(string)) need multiple methods per operation.

convenience-typed-wrapper.note: Two mgmt C# instances; see data-plane split.

credential-client-constructor.note: Key/token constructors are generated when @useAuth lists both schemes; remaining cases add audience, shared-key or challenge pipelines.

custom-auth-header-policy.note: TS has custom-http-auth-header-name; other languages nothing.

custom-model-json-serialization.note: Some cases are encodings (@encode) or C#-only converters (@useSystemTextJsonConverter); envelope codecs are service-specific.

datetime-wire-normalization.note: @encode covers rfc3339/rfc7231/unix/duration seconds; exact fractional-digit formats, floating seconds and relative-or-absolute unions are not.

enum-wire-value-mapping.note: Public member name vs wire value: @clientName on enum members/properties.

extensible-string-enum.note: Generated in every language from unions; samples are C# back-compat structs and a Python enum the spec types as string.

fixed-argument-operation-helper.note: Named method calling a generic op with a fixed payload/flag; needs a second method bound to the same operation.

generated-type-rename.note: Models/clients: @clientName. Emitter-synthesized types (C# ClientOptions, ClientBuilderExtensions) have no TypeSpec node to rename.

handwritten-client-over-generated.note: Client hierarchy/naming via @client/@operationGroup/@clientLocation/@clientInitialization covers part; the rest is layered behavior (caches, managers).

handwritten-public-model.note: Public options/result models defined by hand instead of the generated one.

hide-generated-surface.note: CodeGenSuppress / removed methods map to @access(internal), @scope("!lang") or @convenientAPI(false); mostly an adoption gap.

hide-or-fix-parameters.note: Topic/subscription elevated with @clientInitialization; continuation-token hiding is standard paging; renames with @clientName/@access.

http-status-to-exists-boolean.note: @responseAsBool is HEAD-only; this maps a GET status to exists.

input-shape-normalization.note: Accept string|list|JSON and normalize; union input overloads.

json-string-typed-value.note: Type chosen by content type at runtime.

lro-continuation-token.note: Rehydration exists in some emitters, not uniformly.

lro-custom-poller.note: Standard shapes are covered by Azure.Core LRO decorators; samples are delete-until-gone, initial-200-in-progress and command-driven polling.

lro-operation-id.note: Operation id from Operation-Location surfaced on the poller.

lro-status-field-selection.note: @lroStatus on the status property; adoption gap unless the status is a resource state (then state-based polling).

milliseconds-timespan-property.note: Spec uses int ms; declare duration with @encode("milliseconds"/"seconds", int32).

model-default-value.note: Legacy @clientDefaultValue; Python not supported; nested-object defaults not covered.

model-factory-method.note: C# emitter generates the model factory; handwritten ones are back-compat overloads or fixed-discriminator variants.

model-property-alias.note: Pure renames are @clientName; aliases kept beside the new name and computed properties are not expressible.

model-property-typed-projection.note: @alternateType on a property covers scalar swaps (string -> url); custom value types (Point, RouterValue) are not covered.

model-request-content-conversion.note: NDJSON/JSONL bodies: JsonlStream is expressible but unsupported by all emitters per 13streaming.mdx.

model-type-replacement.note: @alternateType with external types (CloudEvent, shared types); Go/JS samples still hand-edit, and wrapper dictionaries are not an external type.

multipart-form-builder.note: C# generates protocol-only for multipart; default filenames/optional files handwritten elsewhere.

multiple-content-type-dispatch.note: Multiple content types on one op; emitters vary in choosing at runtime.

next-link-handling.note: Next-link/continuation-token paging exists; raw next links needing extra headers, recursive ACL continuation and header-borne tokens are handwritten.

operation-options-extension.note: Internal kwargs helpers that only exist because the methods are handwritten.

page-size-option-alias.note: Rename/omit page-size and filter params with @clientName / @override + removeParameter.

paged-item-model-projection.note: Pager items mapped to public models.

parameter-value-conversion.note: Parameters typed as string in the spec; should be enum/extensible union/uuid/duration.

polymorphic-value-accessor.note: Common accessor across variants; low value.

prefer-header-options.note: Model Prefer values as typed header parameters (enum/union) instead of a free string.

public-constant-definitions.note: Expose the values as an enum/union in the spec.

public-model-mapping.note: Wrapper converts to/from a handwritten public model (Key Vault, App Configuration, CloudEvent).

request-body-encoding.note: C# skips convenience for multipart, merge-patch and content-type-parameter operations.

request-default-header-policy.note: Header with a default value; Legacy @clientDefaultValue (not Python).

request-parameter-reshaping.note: Mostly @clientName on the body parameter ('request' -> 'options'); the rest @override spreads/options bags.

request-precondition-validation.note: Only Java has client-side-validations; most checks are unsupported-option rejections.

resource-identifier-factory.note: ARM has armResourceIdentifier; the factory helpers are C# mgmt.

response-headers-to-model.note: TS has include-headers-in-response; Python/Java build the result from headers by hand.

response-reshaping.note: @responseAsBool covers the HEAD cases (not Go); envelope unwrapping, header projection and 304 -> None are not expressible.

retry-policy-tuning.note: Retry classifiers and backoff are runtime policy.

scoped-subclient-factory.note: Sub-client accessors with parameters via @clientInitialization(initializedBy parent).

sse-typed-event-stream.note: SSEStream expressible; all five emitter tabs say unsupported.

stream-request-content-overload.note: Stream overload beside the typed one.

traced-convenience-method.note: Goes away when the wrapped method is generated.

typed-delete-operation.note: Typed convenience missing for one mgmt delete.

unsupported-operation-error.note: Drop the operation for the language with @scope instead of throwing.
